threat_event: Attacker takes control of an HMI through the integrator's remote desktop agent and changes a chemical feed setpoint
threat_source: Cybercriminal or hacktivist targeting water utilities
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on vendor remote desktop agent; password only; no session approval or logging
existing_controls: Hardwired pump stroke limits; independent pH and chlorine alarms; 24x7 operator in WTP-1 control room
treatment_plan: Remove the always-on agent; vendor access only through a company-controlled remote access gateway with MFA, per-session approval by the Chief Plant Operator, and session recording

threat_event: Password guessing or reused credentials give an attacker on-call VPN access to the HMIs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: VPN uses a password only; appliance firmware 14 months behind; OT accounts not federated to the identity provider
existing_controls: VPN restricted to 9 named on-call users; lockout after 10 failures
treatment_plan: Patch the VPN appliance; enforce MFA through the identity provider; land VPN sessions on a jump host in an OT DMZ instead of the HMI subnet

threat_event: Ransomware on the business network spreads to the SCADA servers and forces manual operation of both plants
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Historian dual-homed to the business network; broad IT/OT firewall rules; flat OT network
existing_controls: IT/OT firewall; antivirus on business endpoints; manual operations drills
treatment_plan: Remove the dual-homed historian; add an OT DMZ with a one-way historian replica path; deny-by-default firewall rules; segment HMIs from PLCs

threat_event: Spoofed telemetry commands on the licensed radio network start or stop a well pump
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy radio protocol has no message authentication
existing_controls: RTUs enforce local run limits; operators see pump status changes on the HMI
treatment_plan: Accept until the radio refresh in the 2028 capital plan; review annually

threat_event: Attacker exploits a known vulnerability in the unsupported operating system on the SCADA servers or engineering workstation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Operating system past end of support; OT patches not applied since 2023
existing_controls: Behind the IT/OT firewall; antivirus on HMIs (definitions updated monthly by hand)
treatment_plan: Upgrade the SCADA servers and engineering workstation with the integrator (2027 capital project); meanwhile harden, remove unused services, and apply vendor-qualified patches quarterly

threat_event: Wiper or ransomware destroys the engineering workstation, the only in-house copy of PLC logic and HMI project files
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No offline backup of PLC logic or HMI projects; integrator copy may be stale
existing_controls: Integrator holds a copy from the 2024 changes
treatment_plan: Monthly and after-change export of PLC logic and HMI projects to encrypted offline media stored at WTP-1 and the administration office; quarterly compare against running logic

threat_event: A workforce member makes an unauthorized setpoint change that cannot be traced to a person
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared HMI operator login; administrator passwords unchanged since 2017
existing_controls: Shift logs; Chief Plant Operator review of alarms each shift
treatment_plan: Named HMI accounts by role; change all default and commissioning passwords; enable HMI audit trail

threat_event: Malicious logic is downloaded to a PLC left in remote-program mode and goes unnoticed
threat_source: Advanced persistent threat targeting critical infrastructure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PLCs at WTP-1 left in remote-program mode; no PLC change detection
existing_controls: Hardwired interlocks on chemical feed
treatment_plan: Set PLC key switches to RUN; written procedure for program mode with Chief Plant Operator approval; quarterly logic comparison

threat_event: An intruder stays in the OT network for weeks because nothing monitors it
threat_source: Advanced persistent threat targeting critical infrastructure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No OT logging or network monitoring; logs only on local HMIs
existing_controls: None for OT
treatment_plan: Passive OT network monitoring sensor at WTP-1 with alerts to the IT Manager and Operations Manager; forward HMI and firewall logs to the log workspace; weekly review

threat_event: A hurricane causes extended utility power loss at the 4 wells without standby generators and at telemetry sites
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 4 of 14 wells lack generators; radio repeaters on commercial power with 8-hour batteries
existing_controls: Generators at both plants and 10 wells; fuel contract; WARN mutual aid
treatment_plan: Add portable generator connections at the 4 wells; extend repeater battery runtime to 72 hours

threat_event: Storm surge or flooding damages WTP-2 electrical and control panels
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: WTP-2 motor control center and PLC panel about 18 inches above grade
existing_controls: WTP-1 can meet average day demand alone
treatment_plan: Raise WTP-2 control panels as part of the 2027 electrical upgrade; add sandbag and panel-cover procedure to the ERP

threat_event: Business email compromise exposes RRA and ERP documents and SCADA diagrams stored in the productivity suite
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: RRA, ERP, and SCADA drawings stored in a shared folder open to all staff; no phishing training
existing_controls: MFA on email
treatment_plan: Restrict the RRA/ERP folder to 6 named roles; label as Restricted (POL-04); phishing training and quarterly simulations

threat_event: Attacker takes over customer portal accounts or breaches the CIS and accesses customer personal information
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Customer portal allows password-only sign-in; CIS administrator roles not reviewed
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 Type 2; MFA for staff CIS access
treatment_plan: Enable the vendor's customer MFA option and credential-stuffing protection; quarterly CIS role review

threat_event: Fraudulent change of a vendor's bank account diverts a large payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No call-back verification for bank detail changes
existing_controls: Dual approval for payments over $25,000
treatment_plan: Call-back verification to a known number for any bank detail change; staff training

threat_event: A compromised SCADA integrator pushes a malicious or faulty project update
threat_source: Supply chain compromise at the integrator
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No security terms in the integrator contract; changes not reviewed before loading
existing_controls: Integrator changes scheduled with the Operations Manager
treatment_plan: Add security terms at renewal (incident notice, named staff, remote access rules, change packages with hash); test changes offline before loading

threat_event: The company misses the 24-hour Tier 1 public notice after a cyber-caused treatment interruption
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ERP cyber section is one page; no link between cyber response and public notification
existing_controls: Tier 1 and boil water notice templates; hurricane experience
treatment_plan: OT cyber playbook in the ERP with a decision point for Tier 1 notice and primacy agency consultation within 24 hours

threat_event: The revised ERP is not certified to EPA by 2026-12-26, or is certified without the cyber findings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: RRA cyber element is thin; ERP owner has limited time; no project plan
existing_controls: 2021 ERP on file
treatment_plan: Project plan with monthly status to the General Manager; RRA cyber addendum by 2026-11-13; ERP certified by 2026-12-11

threat_event: An operator overfeeds or underfeeds a chemical while running a plant manually after SCADA is lost
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual procedures drilled twice a year but not written for every chemical; staffing strain during long outages
existing_controls: Hardwired stroke limits; independent analyzer alarms; licensed operators
treatment_plan: Written manual-mode procedures for each chemical feed; add to drills; staffing plan for 72 hours of manual operation

threat_event: An intruder at the unstaffed WTP-2 at night damages chemical storage or feed equipment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: WTP-2 unstaffed at night; cameras monitored only on alarm
existing_controls: Fence; card access; intrusion alarm to WTP-1
treatment_plan: Add motion analytics to WTP-2 cameras with alert to the WTP-1 control room

threat_event: Deliberate contamination through a storage tank hatch at a remote site
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tank hatches locked but not alarmed at 2 of 4 tanks
existing_controls: Fenced sites; locked hatches; chlorine residual analyzers at tank outlets
treatment_plan: Hatch intrusion switches at the 2 remaining tanks wired to RTUs

threat_event: Loss of the radio link blinds operators to remote sites during a storm
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single radio path to 18 sites; no automatic fallback
existing_controls: RTUs run on local control; roving operator checks
treatment_plan: Cellular fallback on the 6 largest sites after modem hardening

threat_event: Operators rely on the anomaly detection model and miss a real water quality event it fails to flag
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot not validated; no documented performance threshold
existing_controls: SCADA hard-limit alarms and grab sampling unchanged
treatment_plan: Validation test before production; model output labeled advisory; SCADA alarms stay primary (P10)

threat_event: False alarms from the anomaly detection model cause alarm fatigue or unnecessary flushing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No tuning or alert review process
existing_controls: Alerts go to email only during the pilot
treatment_plan: Weekly alert review during the pilot; precision target in P10

threat_event: Compromise of a cloud administrator account lets an attacker tamper with the historian replica and the anomaly model
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two IT staff share one cloud administrator role; no alerting on configuration changes
existing_controls: MFA on the cloud console
treatment_plan: Named administrator roles; alerts on role and storage policy changes

threat_event: Business-system backups are deleted along with production in the cloud account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backup vault in the same account and region as production; never restore-tested
existing_controls: Daily backups
treatment_plan: Separate backup account with immutable retention; quarterly restore test

threat_event: A lost field tablet exposes cached customer data or system maps
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tablets have a PIN but no remote wipe
existing_controls: Device PIN
treatment_plan: Mobile device management with remote wipe

threat_event: A departed employee still has a local HMI or VPN account and uses it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT accounts are local and not tied to the HR termination process
existing_controls: HR emails IT at termination (business accounts only)
treatment_plan: Add OT accounts to the termination checklist; monthly OT account reconciliation

threat_event: An AMI vendor outage stops meter reads for a billing cycle
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single AMI head-end; no contract recovery commitment
existing_controls: Handheld read capability for non-AMI meters
treatment_plan: Estimated bills per tariff rules; accepted

threat_event: A CIS vendor outage stops billing and call-center account lookups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS; call center depends on it
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 availability commitments (P09)
treatment_plan: Covered by vendor recovery commitments; accepted

threat_event: A LIMS outage delays monthly compliance reporting
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Lab results depend on the LIMS and the contract lab portal
existing_controls: Contract lab emails PDF reports
treatment_plan: Accepted; paper bench sheets as fallback

threat_event: Attacker signs in to an internet-reachable cellular modem with default credentials and reaches a well RTU
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Web administration exposed on the carrier network with default credentials at 4 well sites (found in P07 testing)
existing_controls: Web administration disabled and passwords changed on 2026-08-06 (emergency fix)
treatment_plan: Carrier private network with no public addressing; modem hardening standard; quarterly external exposure scan

threat_event: Staff paste RRA, ERP, or SCADA details into a public generative AI tool
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No approved-tools rule for AI; no training
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Approved AI tools rule (POL-05 4.8); training
